import type { D1Database } from '@cloudflare/workers-types';
import type { D1DatabaseBinding, D1Result, D1Statement } from 'turbine-orm/d1';
import { turbine, type TurbineClient } from './generated/index.js';
import { ReplayApp, type Command, type Event } from './application.js';
function negative(db: TurbineClient) {
  // @ts-expect-error D1 factory requires a binding
  turbine('file:db');
  // @ts-expect-error no interactive D1 transaction
  db.$transaction(async () => 1);
  // @ts-expect-error no invented D1 notifications
  db.$listen('events');
  // @ts-expect-error exact quantity is TEXT, not a JS bigint
  const invalid: Command = {eventId:'e',orderId:'o',quantity:1n,amount:'1.000000000000',occurredAt:'2026-11-07T00:00:00.000000Z',title:null,body:new Uint8Array()};
  // @ts-expect-error unknown field
  db.replayEvents.findMany({select:{missing:true}});
  void invalid;
}
void negative;
export async function run(binding: D1Database) {
  const shape: D1DatabaseBinding = binding;
  const statement: D1Statement = {sql:'SELECT 1'};
  const results: D1Result[] = await binding.batch([binding.prepare(statement.sql)]);
  const app = new ReplayApp(shape);
  const command: Command = {eventId:'generated',orderId:'generated',quantity:'9223372036854775807',amount:'999999999999999999999999999999.120000000001',occurredAt:'2026-11-07T12:34:56.123456Z',title:null,body:new Uint8Array([0,128,255])};
  const event: Event = await app.append('generated',command);
  const db = turbine(shape,{warnOnUnlimited:false});
  const selected = await db.replayEvents.findMany({where:{tenant:'generated'},select:{position:true,captured:true}});
  const text: string = selected[0]!.captured;
  const position: number = selected[0]!.position;
  // @ts-expect-error selected rows do not expose tenant
  selected[0]!.tenant;
  const [count,orders] = await db.$batch([db.replayEvents.buildCount({where:{tenant:'generated'}}),db.replayOrders.buildFindMany({where:{tenant:'generated'}})]);
  if(count!==1 || orders[0]?.captured!==text || position!==1 || results.length!==1) throw Error('Generated native query mismatch');
  const values = JSON.parse(text);
  if(values[2]!==command.quantity || values[3]!==command.amount || values[4]!==command.occurredAt || values[5]!==null || values[6]!=='0080ff') throw Error('Generated exact TEXT values');
  await db.disconnect(); await app.close();
  await shape.prepare('SELECT 1').all();
  return {position,count,values,event};
}
